cards.example_en: A tiny creature moved under the leaf.
cards.example_zh: 一只小生物在叶子下移动。

cards.example_en: The stage crew moved the piano during the interval.
cards.example_zh: 负责舞台的全体人员在中场休息时挪走了钢琴。

cards.example_en: Spraying paint on the school wall is a crime, not a joke.
cards.example_zh: 往学校墙上喷漆是罪行，不是开玩笑。

cards.example_en: These apple slices are crisp and sweet after a day in the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 这些苹果片在冰箱里放了一天后又脆又甜。

cards.example_en: A crocodile lay still beside the pool at the wildlife park.
cards.example_zh: 一只鳄鱼一动不动地躺在野生动物园的水池边。

cards.example_en: Hail flattened the tomato crop in my uncle's greenhouse.
cards.example_zh: 冰雹砸倒了我叔叔温室里的番茄作物。

cards.example_en: Grandma finishes the crossword in the newspaper every morning.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶每天早上都做完报纸上的纵横填字游戏。

cards.example_en: A large crowd waited outside the stadium.
cards.example_zh: 一大群人在体育场外等候。

cards.example_en: The queen wore a gold crown in the history museum display.
cards.example_zh: 历史博物馆的展品中，女王戴着一顶金王冠。

cards.example_en: It is cruel to hurt an animal.
cards.example_zh: 伤害动物是残酷的。

cards.example_en: The film showed the cruelty of war through one family's story.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影通过一个家庭的故事展现了战争的残忍。

cards.example_en: The plates are in the cupboard.
cards.example_zh: 盘子在橱柜里。

cards.example_en: Curiosity led him to open the old box in the attic.
cards.example_zh: 好奇心促使他打开了阁楼里那个旧箱子。

cards.example_en: Her curly hair gets bigger whenever the weather turns humid.
cards.example_zh: 天气变得潮湿时，她的卷发会蓬得更大。

cards.example_en: I opened the curtain and saw frost on the football pitch.
cards.example_zh: 我拉开窗帘，看见足球场上结了一层霜。

cards.example_en: Sharing mooncakes is a family custom on Mid-Autumn night.
cards.example_zh: 中秋夜分月饼是我们家的习俗。

cards.example_en: Cycling along the river path is my favourite weekend exercise.
cards.example_zh: 沿河骑行是我最喜欢的周末运动。

cards.example_en: The storm caused serious damage.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨造成严重破坏。

cards.example_en: I dare not jump from that height.
cards.example_zh: 我不敢从那么高的地方跳。

cards.example_en: He started to daydream and missed the bus stop near school.
cards.example_zh: 他开始做白日梦，错过了学校附近的公交站。

cards.example_en: The museum is free in the daytime on the first Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆在第一个星期日的白天免费开放。

cards.example_en: Write the answer as a decimal instead of a whole number.
cards.example_zh: 把答案写成小数，不要写成整数。

cards.example_en: It was a difficult decision to make.
cards.example_zh: 那是一个非常艰难的决定。

cards.example_en: Red lanterns were the main decoration at the New Year party.
cards.example_zh: 红灯笼是新年聚会上的主要装饰。

cards.example_en: Our team hopes to defeat the champions.
cards.example_zh: 我们队希望击败冠军队。

cards.example_en: Thick coats defend us against the cold winter wind.
cards.example_zh: 厚外套能帮我们挡住冬天的寒风。

cards.example_en: We should definitely leave before six.
cards.example_zh: 我们肯定得在六点前走。

cards.example_en: The postman will deliver the parcel today.
cards.example_zh: 邮递员今天会投递这个包裹。

cards.example_en: They booked a deluxe room with a sea view for the holiday.
cards.example_zh: 他们为假期订了一间看海的豪华房间。

cards.example_en: The toy department is on the third floor.
cards.example_zh: 玩具店在三楼。

cards.example_en: Young chicks are dependent on the hen for warmth.
cards.example_zh: 小鸡要靠母鸡来取暖。

cards.example_en: He felt depressed after losing the final match by one point.
cards.example_zh: 决赛以一分之差落败后，他感到很沮丧。

cards.example_en: Give a short description of your house.
cards.example_zh: 请简要描述您的房源。

cards.example_en: Rome is a popular tourist destination.
cards.example_zh: 罗马是热门的旅游目的地。

cards.example_en: A strong storm can destroy crops in the fields.
cards.example_zh: 强风暴可能会毁掉田里的庄稼。

cards.example_en: One detail in the photo showed a cat sitting on the roof.
cards.example_zh: 照片里的一个细节显示屋顶上坐着一只猫。

cards.example_en: Label the diagram of the heart.
cards.example_zh: 给心脏图做标注。

cards.example_en: Their opinions differ on this point.
cards.example_zh: 他们在这一点上意见不同。

cards.example_en: We dine at my uncle's house every Sunday evening.
cards.example_zh: 每个星期日晚上，我们都在叔叔家吃饭。

cards.example_en: The museum has a dinosaur skeleton.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆里有一具恐龙骨架。

cards.example_en: Dip the dumpling in vinegar before you take a bite.
cards.example_zh: 咬一口饺子之前，先在醋里蘸一下。

cards.example_en: Which direction is the station?
cards.example_zh: 车站在哪个方向？

cards.example_en: There is dirt on your shoes, so leave them by the door.
cards.example_zh: 你的鞋上沾着污垢，把它们放在门口吧。

cards.example_en: She stared in disbelief when her name appeared on the screen.
cards.example_zh: 看到自己的名字出现在屏幕上时，她难以置信地盯着看。

cards.example_en: A family discussion ended with pizza instead of leftover stew.
cards.example_zh: 家里讨论到最后，决定吃披萨，不吃剩炖菜。

cards.example_en: Save the file on a disk.
cards.example_zh: 把文件存在磁盘上。

cards.example_en: The distance from the dorm to the gym is about ten minutes on foot.
cards.example_zh: 从宿舍走到体育馆，距离大约是十分钟。

cards.example_en: Our district finally got a swimming pool open to students on Sundays.
cards.example_zh: 我们这个地区终于有了周日对学生开放的游泳池。

cards.example_en: Please do not disturb the meeting.
cards.example_zh: 请不要打扰会议。

cards.example_en: She can dive from the low board.
cards.example_zh: 她能从低跳板跳水。

word.example_en: We need to make a decision before Friday.
word.example_zh: 我们需要在星期五前做决定。
